# Liberated Bread DNS blocklist: profile 'cloud', all devices, format 'hosts'
# Generated from cloud.egress in https://github.com/liberatedbread/liberatedbread-protocol-specs
# by scripts/generate_blocklists.py. Do not edit this file; fix the spec.
#
# Every host the device itself contacts, except time sources. The DNS half of cutting
# the device off from its vendor; the firewall rule is the other half.
#
# A DNS list is the second layer. A device that ignores your resolver walks
# straight past it, so firewall the device as well: https://liberatedbread.com/firewall/
#
# A hosts file matches exact names only. Rules marked (and subdomains) cover only the
# name shown here; use the dnsmasq, Unbound, AdGuard or RPZ list to catch the rest.
#
# Devices:
#   June Intelligent Oven (june-oven)
#   LG webOS TV Second Screen Protocol (lg-webos)
#   TP-Link Kasa Smart Plug (tplink-kasa-smart-plug)
#
# Time sources. NOT blocked: a device that loses its clock loses its schedules.
# Point these at a LAN NTP server (your router, or chrony on any always-on host),
# or regenerate with --time-server <address> to have the redirect written for you:
#   pool.ntp.org (and subdomains)  [tplink-kasa-smart-plug | time | reported]
#   time.nist.gov  [tplink-kasa-smart-plug | time | reported]
#
# Left out, because blocking them breaks the device or its clock:
#   - lgtvsdp.com (lg-webos): The TV takes its clock from this service — a header on its
#     HTTPS API rather than NTP — and the Content Store, app updates and home-screen
#     configuration live here too. Blocked, the clock resets after a cold boot (to
#     2019-12-31 on one report) and apps then fail their certificate checks.
#   - nextlgsdp.com (lg-webos): The newer SDP family: blocking it is reported to stop
#     the TV setting its clock and to disable the Content Store.
#   - ngfts.lge.com (lg-webos): Content Store icons and screenshots, EULA acceptance and
#     app downloads fail.
#   - lgtvonline.lge.com (lg-webos): The TV's internet-connection check fails and it
#     reports itself offline. One list's author says it must stay reachable; other lists
#     block it. What else follows from a failed check is not documented.
#
# Read before applying. Blocking these has a cost on some units:
#   - deventry.tplinkcloud.com (tplink-kasa-smart-plug, impact unknown): TP-Link staff
#     say an HS103 (hardware 2, firmware 1.1.2) must be able to resolve this name and
#     devs-gw.tplinkcloud.com; what fails when it cannot is not stated.
#   - devs-gw.tplinkcloud.com (tplink-kasa-smart-plug, impact unknown): TP-Link staff
#     say an HS103 (hardware 2, firmware 1.1.2) must be able to resolve this name and
#     deventry.tplinkcloud.com; what fails when it cannot is not stated.
#   - lgtvcommon.com (lg-webos, impact degraded): Home-screen recommendation and
#     promotion rows stop loading. The beacon and crash-upload services here go with
#     them; nothing else is reported to break.
#   - n-devs.tplinkcloud.com (tplink-kasa-smart-plug, impact degraded): Off-LAN control
#     through the Kasa app, Alexa and Google Assistant stops, and so do app-driven
#     updates. On a set of 2023 builds a device that cannot reach its cloud also drops
#     and rejoins Wi-Fi every 10 minutes: TP-Link lists KP125/EP25 1.0.10, EP40A 1.0.5,
#     KP303 v2 1.0.7, HS103 v5 1.0.8, HS200 v5 1.0.10, HS210 v3 1.0.9, HS220 v3 1.0.10,
#     KS200 1.0.5 and KS220 1.0.9, and says fixed builds have shipped — which fixes it
#     only by taking an update. Workaround: Unbind the device first (cnCloud.unbind, or
#     smartlife.iot.common.cloud.unbind on a bulb) — it needs the cloud reachable, so do
#     it before blocking. It stopped the reconnect loop for one owner, though an HS220
#     on 1.0.10 kept looping until the fixed build. Failing that, resolve this name to a
#     LAN machine that accepts the TCP connection instead of to a null address; a device
#     answered that way was reported to settle where a refused one did not.
#   - n-use1-devs.tplinkcloud.com (tplink-kasa-smart-plug, impact degraded): The US
#     regional form of n-devs.tplinkcloud.com, with the same cost: off-LAN control,
#     voice assistants and app-driven updates stop, and the 2023 builds listed there
#     reconnect Wi-Fi every 10 minutes. Workaround: As for n-devs.tplinkcloud.com:
#     unbind before blocking, or answer the connection on the LAN.
#
# Each rule below is preceded by: devices | roles | verification.
# 'reported' and 'hypothesis' entries have not been observed by this project.
